author: ohtadmin
title: Town will apply for $96K grant to help pave local roads
text:
Town Administrator Ed Mello has been given permission to execute a grant application that seeks $95,807 from the Rhode Island Department of Transportation.
“This will be the third year in a row that the state has made available funds to augment local funds for municipal paving,” he said.
The town council approved Mello’s request at its Aug. 18 meeting.
The money, which must be spent by November 2028, requires the town to spend at least twice that amount. So, if the grant were awarded, Jamestown would have to commit at least $191,615. That share, however, has yet to be committed.
“Just as a point of budgeting, we have not budgeted that 67 percent,” Mello said. “We could do that in the future fiscal year. The money that’s budgeted in the current fiscal year is already part of a match program. Combined with last year’s capital funds and last year’s grant funds, that total is about $1 million for road paving, which is still underway as we are working with our contractor to get about 4.5 miles of road to get repaved.”
That 4.5 miles includes reclamation and paving on Beach Avenue from Spirketing Street to Seaside Drive; Bonnet View Drive; a section of Bryer Avenue about 200 feet west of Conanicus Avenue; Collins Terrace; High Street from Howland Avenue to Baldwin Court; Highland Drive from Blueberry Lane to Ledge Road; Highland Drive from Hamilton Avenue to Juniper Circle; Ocean Avenue from Watson Avenue to the northern terminus; Ship Street; Seaside Drive from Frigate Street to Catamaran Avenue; Sloop Street from Beacon Avenue to Umiak Avenue; Watson Avenue from Ocean Avenue to West Bay View Drive; Umiak Avenue; and Whale Rock Road.
The plan also includes pavement overlays on Arnold Avenue from Westwind Drive to North Road; Baldwin Court; Clinton Avenue from High Street to the southern terminus; Cole Street from High Street to the southern terminus; Columbia Avenue from High Street to the southern terminus; Fowler Street from Valley Street to Luther Street; Marine Avenue; Maple Avenue from Narragansett Avenue to Spring Street; Pierce Avenue; Maple Avenue; Pleasant View Drive; and Spring Street.
